_template_note: Template / frozen field spec for DecoderContextV1 (plan §5.2–§5.7; ADR-0034 §3). V5.4.3's real deliverable is this data contract, not a decoder weight: a read-only, typed, immutable context that carries everything a Refiner may see and nothing else. A Decoder receives ONLY its own read-only view (MoveContextV1 or ProcessContextV1) — it never receives `batch`, `pos`, or any supervision key. Fill the *_sha256 fields at Bridge freeze (WP2) and re-hash into bridge_spec_sha256.

key_v.source: Bridge construction (§5.3, 8 deterministic channels, channel 0 = u0/a_ref)

u0.source: DirectMoveDecoder (V542 w_v = 49 params, same five tensors)

key_ptr.source: prefix sum of keys per graph

key_edge_attr.source: Bridge construction (d, RBF(d;2,3,4,5) x4, |delta_b|, is_changed, edge_type)

pair_s.source: Bridge construction (§5.4, 48-dim fixed layout, no pair_index/pair_edit reads)

intent_pair_index.source: Bridge construction; canonical key-slot order, NOT a chemical arrow

pair_ptr.source: prefix sum of pairs per graph

token_index.source: layout: per graph [graph, keys..., pairs...]; -1 for the graph token

token_ptr.source: prefix sum of tokens per graph

shape_constraints.ptr_monotone: key_ptr / pair_ptr / token_ptr are non-decreasing, start at 0, end at the corresponding total
shape_constraints.empty_pair_allowed: P = 0 (no changed K-pair) => pair_s is [0,48]; every decoder must handle the empty-pair case
shape_constraints.empty_edge_allowed: Ek = 0 is legal; M3 must degrade to no message passing

ProcessContextV1.consumer: ProcessRefiner (P1/P2/P3/P4 formal, P4-C matched control; P5 conditional)

read_only_views.isolation_rule: 两个 Read-only 视图互斥: MOVE 不能读 PROCESS 状态 (q0_raw/endpoint0_logit/pair_s/token_*), PROCESS 不能读 MOVE 初猜 u0 或向量基底 key_v/key_edge_*. 两个视图都不含 pos、监督键、绝对坐标、历史帧。
read_only_views.required_test: test_v543_track_view_isolation 必须断言 MoveContextV1 没有 q0_raw/endpoint0_logit, ProcessContextV1 没有 u0/key_v
read_only_views.why: 如果 MOVE 能读 q0_raw 它会用 PROCESS 的进度作弊; 如果 PROCESS 能读 u0 它会从 MOVE 的位移反推进度; V543 要回答的是两条独立专家各自能从同一份 Encoder 表征学到什么

channels.0: u0[k] / a_ref (继承 MOVE 初猜; 除 a_ref 变成无量纲)
channels.1: sum_{e: dst=k, delta_b_e<0} |delta_b_e| * unit_e / sum|delta_b_e| (断键方向)
channels.2: sum_{e: dst=k, delta_b_e>0} |delta_b_e| * unit_e / sum|delta_b_e| (成键方向)
channels.3: sum_{e: dst=k, delta_b_e=0, covalent} unit_e / count (不变共价边方向)
channels.4: sum_{e: dst=k, spatial} kappa(d_e) * unit_e / sum kappa, kappa(d)=exp(-((d-3.0)/1.0)^2)
channels.5: sum_{p: k in pair, changed K-pair} sign(delta_b_p) * (x[other]-x[k])/(norm+0.1) / count
channels.6: sum_{e: dst=k} (d_e/4.0) * unit_e / sum(d_e/4.0) (距离加权全边均值)
channels.7: (mean_{j in K, j != k} x[j] - x[k]) / (norm + 0.1) (指向关键原子质心)

rules: zero denominator => zero vector for that channel, never NaN
only pos differences, delta_b, is_changed, is_covalent, is_spatial, key_index — no absolute coordinates
channel 0 is linearly dependent on u0: S0-C must report coverage WITH and WITHOUT channel 0 (no self-证)
the 8 channels are a cheap equivariant read-out basis, not a claim of expressing the true action; S0-B/S0-C decide sufficiency

pair_s_layout.pair_definition: changed K-pair (i,j) with i<j in key-slot canonical order

blocks.40-47: W_fixed @ (key_s[i] - key_s[j]); W_fixed is a fixed 8x48 +-1/sqrt(48) matrix (persistent=False, no trainable parameters)
blocks.note: 0-31 are frozen in the Bridge spec (§5.4) at WP2 freeze; this template pins the layout rules (canonical order, signed delta_b, forward edges only, 48 dims) and the two sketch blocks needed for the parameter-free guarantee — the full block table is frozen by bridge_spec_sha256, never edited here

forbidden_inputs.runtime_audit: assert_no_supervision(ctx): for name in SUPERVISION_KEYS_V3: assert not hasattr(ctx, name); for forbidden in ('pos','xyz','pair_edit','y_teacher','q_true'): assert not hasattr(ctx, forbidden)
forbidden_inputs.slots_rule: DecoderContextV1 的 __slots__ 只含冻结字段; __getattr__ 不得回退到 batch

cache_key: source_frame_identity (curve_id + node_index + intent_id + d0 canonical hash)
cache_contract.content: only the DecoderContextV1 tensor fields + schema/identity; never y_teacher/q_true/endpoint/frame_weight/sample_id/curve_id
rules: joint_finetune must build live and keep autograd; detached cache reads forbidden
cache is built after the split; inner-train + inner-val only; dev/confirm never cached
shard by curve (256 curves/shard), RAM LRU 1-2 GB, disk <= 30 GB, hit-rate target >= 80%
identity/SHA/schema mismatch => refuse the hit and rebuild; never silently reuse

decoder_contract.MoveDecoderProtocol: forward(ctx: MoveContextV1) -> delta_u [K,3] in angstrom (K rows are key-only, so non-key zero rows are structurally impossible)
decoder_contract.trust_boundary: Decoder 不得私自实现数据读取、损失定义、checkpoint 选择; 统一由 v543_train.py 负责
